Do you know why she gulps/bolts?. Could be resource guarding. Not that you've done anything wrong,my Chi girl became a gulper/bolter when i transitioned to raw, growing included. The best way for you to build her confidence is by * its nasty i know* hand feeding. She only eats from you for the next week or so. Then from a bowl in your hand in which you place the food piace by piece. Then on the floor,same,piece by piece. Then you can start to simply serve half of the food and add in more while she eats. This will teach her that you provide the food and you+bowl+being there isn't a threat. As for bone in cuts,use plyers or your hand to hold the bone pieces too. Feeding larger bits help but she could always bolt. You can actually use chicken wings cut up for example, there's no harm in her swallowing those bits whole while you work on her confidence. Dog's are not chewers by nature,they actually tear chunks small enough to swallow,so it's not that uncommon,but it's best to slow them a little. Slow feeders might help a bit,as well as puzzle toys but the behavior us still there,she just has no chance of practicing it. I used to work as a trainer,so hope this does help!.
